art_direction: Editorial Brutalism meets Vintage Comic Print. Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level. High contrast, visible grid lines, halftone/noise textures, and deliberate typography. It blends the gritty nostalgia of 80s French comic monthlies (Strange, Nova, Titans) and VO US comics with premium, modern fashion-ecommerce presentation.

primary_heading.usage: Main page headings, hero typography, section titles. Gives the premium editorial look.

secondary_heading.usage: Massive background kinetic text, marquee ribbons, chapter numbers. Adds the punchy 'comic book' blocky feel.

body.usage: Product details, prices, admin dashboard data, small utility text. Provides a structured, archival contrast to the wild headings.

background.description: Warm 'Newsprint' off-white. Avoid pure white. Gives the tactile feel of vintage comic pages.

text.description: Rich Ink Black for maximum contrast.

accents.description: Used sparingly for CTAs, active states, and hover reveals. Represents classic comic print colors.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay across the entire storefront to kill the 'digital flatness' and simulate paper.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)'. Visible 1px solid borders (#0A0A0A or border-black/15) separating major layout sections, creating a structured, panel-like comic page layout.
visual_enhancers.radius: Storefront: rounded-none (Brutalist, sharp edges). Admin: rounded-md (functional).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard, solid drop shadows. Example: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]. Avoid soft blurry shadows on the storefront.

layouts_and_grids.storefront: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical spans. A 12-column grid where the main product hero takes 8 columns and the details take 4. Leave empty cells for breathing room.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for padding between major sections. Inner card padding must be at least p-6.
layouts_and_grids.admin_dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. 4-column strict grid. Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized for functional inventory management.

header.style: Solid Background. bg-[#F4F1EA] with a hard bottom border (border-black). Z-index 50. Sticky.
header.navigation: Logo left, 4 links center, Cart/CTA right. Visible on desktop. No transparent header.

hero_section.style: Kinetic Hero. Split layout. Left: Massive typography (Cabinet Grotesk) with a masked line-by-line reveal animation on load. Right/Background: Abstract or tight crop of vintage comic art with max bg-black/30 overlay if text overlaps.

marquee.style: The 'Editorial Ribbon'. Slow moving, font-mono or Anton, small/medium text, massive gaps between words. Border top and bottom to lock it in place.

product_catalog.style: Grid layout with visible borders separating products. Images use mix-blend-multiply on the off-white background to blend perfectly. Hover states trigger the hard solid shadow and image slight scale.

product_detail.style: Massive spotlight. Real cover photography treated deliberately. 50/50 split screen on desktop. Left is sticky photo, Right is scrolling details and Stripe checkout integration.

manifesto_section.style: Numbered chapters about the shop's story. Huge typographic numbers (01, 02) using 'Anton' font. High contrast off-white on black section to break the rhythm.

conventions_section.style: Photography heavy. Showcasing European comic conventions. Asymmetrical image grid (Tetris mode). overlapping images with date/location labels in uppercase mono font.

admin_dashboard.style: Separate route/layout. Functional, clean. Sidebar navigation. Data tables for inventory (VO vs VF, strange, nova). Use Shadcn UI heavily customized with sharp corners and high contrast.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for the storefront.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: initial={y: '100%'} animate={y: 0} with overflow-hidden wrapper for the line-by-line text reveal.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering a comic cover: transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease. Add a slight rotation (rotate-1 or rotate-2) to mimic picking up a physical comic book.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Keep them snappy. No slow crossfades.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure hover color contrasts.

hero_bg.description: A collection of vintage Marvel comic books overlapping. Use for hero visual or manifesto background.

product_spotlight.description: Vintage Iron Man comic held by hand. Use for featured product detail section.

catalog_placeholders.description: Pile of comics sitting next to each other.
Joker comic book on brown table.

conventions.description: Lively crowd at Comic Con. Use for the European conventions/salons section.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans', or 'Lato' for headings. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for primary headings and 'Anton' for massive typographic elements.
Maximum heading size is text-6xl. Do not use text-7xl, 8xl, or 9xl for standard hero text. You may use fluid clamp() techniques within bounds.
Apply a subtle grain/noise SVG texture overlay with pointer-events-none fixed to the viewport.
Use 'Grid Borders'. Create a structural, panel-like layout using border-collapse or direct borders (border-black/15) around sections.
Do not apply global 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties (transform, opacity) on interactive elements.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, cart toggles) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
Header must have a solid or highly blurred background (bg-[#F4F1EA] border-b). Never fully transparent if content scrolls beneath.
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactive parts (Dialogs, Selects, Toasts via Sonner), but heavily customize them: remove soft radii (rounded-none), use hard borders, and high contrast active states.
For product images on light backgrounds, use 'mix-blend-multiply' to simulate ink printed directly on the page.
Implement a separate Admin layout that prioritizes density, functional grids, and slightly softer UI (rounded-md) compared to the brutalist storefront.
Use Lucide-react for standard icons, but prefer typography over icons where possible to maintain the editorial print vibe.
